Estimate the LC50 by the graphical method

Source: R/point_estimation.R
graphical_lc50.Rd

Interpolates between the two concentrations that bracket 50 per cent response, on a logarithmic concentration scale. The EPA flowchart selects this method when there are no partial responses, so no model can be fitted.

Usage

graphical_lc50(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A tox_data() object, or a data frame that can be coerced to one by passing it through tox_data().

...

Additional arguments passed to tox_data() when x is a bare data frame, and otherwise unused.

Value

An object of class tox_estimate.

Details

The proportions are smoothed and adjusted for control response first, then the estimate is read off the straight line joining the two bracketing points on semi-logarithmic axes, which is linear interpolation in log10(conc).

No confidence interval is available. The manual gives none, and with no partial response there is no information from which to construct one.

References

US EPA (2002) EPA-821-R-02-012, section 11.2.2.

Examples

# Acute Table 20, all-or-nothing column; the manual reads 35 per cent off
# the plot, and interpolation gives 35.4.
graphical_lc50(
  acute_table20,
  response = "graphical", n_exposed = "exposed", type = "quantal"
)
#> Graphical method
#>   EPA-821-R-02-012 section 11.2.2
#> 
#>  endpoint  p estimate lower upper ci_method
#>      LC50 50   35.355    NA    NA      <NA>
